questions.question: Which flag of the Indian National Congress was adopted in 1931?

options.text: A two colour flag with charkha made by cloth
A tricolour flag made by Khadi with a Charkha symbol
One colour flag with charkha symbol
A blue colour flag made by cloth

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A tricolour flag made by Khadi with a Charkha symbol**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A tricolour flag made by Khadi with a Charkha symbol** was adopted by the Indian National Congress in 1931.
 
• This flag consisted of three horizontal stripes: saffron at the top, white in the middle, and green at the bottom.
 
• A Charkha (spinning wheel) was placed in the center of the white stripe, symbolizing self-reliance and the Swadeshi movement.
 
• The adoption of this flag was a significant move towards the final design of the Indian national flag.
 
• This flag represented the spirit of unity and the desire for independence from British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian National Congress played a pivotal role in the Indian independence movement against British colonial rule.
 
• The tricolour flag adopted in 1931 laid the foundation for the current national flag of India.
 
• The current national flag of India was adopted on July 22, 1947, and it retains the tricolour scheme with the Ashoka Chakra replacing the Charkha.
 
• The flag symbolizes India's rich heritage, its commitment to peace, and its aspiration for progress.

questions.question: Among the following pairs, which ones denote two scalar quantities?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2) Distance and Speed**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Distance** and **Speed** are both scalar quantities.
 
• A **scalar quantity** is defined by only its magnitude and has no direction.
 
• **Distance** refers to the total path length traveled by an object, irrespective of its direction.
 
• **Speed** is the rate at which an object covers distance, and it is also direction-independent.
 
• Other options like **Momentum**, **Angular velocity**, **Linear momentum**, **Acceleration**, **Electric field**, and **Force** are vector quantities, which have both magnitude and direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **vector quantity** is characterized by both magnitude and direction.
 
• Examples of vector quantities include **velocity, force, acceleration, and momentum**.
 
• Understanding the distinction between scalar and vector quantities is fundamental in the study of physics and engineering.
 
• In practical applications, scalar quantities are often simpler to work with due to their lack of directional component.

questions.question: Which of the following vitamins prevents major birth defects of the brain and spine of a newborn baby?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Folic acid**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Folic acid** is essential in preventing major birth defects of the brain and spine in a newborn baby.
 
• Folic acid, also known as vitamin B9, plays a crucial role in cell growth and the formation of DNA.
 
• It is particularly important during the early stages of pregnancy for the proper development of the neural tube.
 
• Deficiency in folic acid during pregnancy can lead to neural tube defects such as spina bifida and anencephaly.
 
• Women of childbearing age are advised to take folic acid supplements to ensure they have adequate levels before and during pregnancy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Folic acid** can be found in various foods such as leafy green vegetables, citrus fruits, beans, and fortified cereals.
 
• The recommended daily intake of folic acid for women of childbearing age is **400 micrograms**.
 
• Folic acid is a water-soluble vitamin, meaning it dissolves in water and excess amounts are excreted from the body.
 
• It is important to start taking folic acid supplements at least one month before conception and continue through the first trimester of pregnancy.
 
• Public health campaigns often emphasize the importance of folic acid supplementation to prevent birth defects.

questions.question: When the ‘trans-boundary economic activities’ of an economy and depreciation are included into account, the aggregate measure is known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**GNP**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GNP** stands for Gross National Product.
 
• GNP includes the value of all goods and services produced by a country's residents, regardless of the location of the production.
 
• It accounts for 'trans-boundary economic activities' by including the income earned by residents from overseas investments and subtracting the income earned within the domestic economy by foreign residents.
 
• Depreciation is subtracted from GNP to get Net National Product (NNP).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** measures the value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders.
 
• **Net National Product (NNP)** is derived by subtracting depreciation from GNP.
 
• **Per Capita Income (PCI)** is the average income earned per person in a given area in a specified year.
 
• GNP is a more comprehensive measure than GDP as it considers the income from abroad.

questions.question: Which mountain range from the following is associated with Rajasthan state?

__
 
• The **Aravalli Range** is the oldest mountain range in India.
 
• This range runs across the Indian states of **Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, and Delhi**.
 
• It spans approximately 692 km in a northeast-southwest direction, starting from **Delhi** and ending in **Gujarat**.
 
• The Aravalli Range plays a crucial role in **preventing the spread of the Thar Desert** towards the fertile plains in the eastern part of Rajasthan.

• The range is rich in natural resources and has significant **ecological and economic importance**.

• The name **'Aravalli'** means 'line of peaks'.
 
• The range is known for its rich biodiversity, including various species of flora and fauna.
 
• It is also home to several historical and cultural landmarks, including forts and temples.
 
• The highest peak in the Aravalli Range is **Guru Shikhar**, which is located in Mount Abu, Rajasthan.
 
• The Aravalli Range is an example of a **fold mountain** system that has undergone significant erosion over geological time.

questions.question: Which of the following represents disposable income?

options.text: The income earned by individuals and households after taxes and other deductions
The total income earned by businesses and corporations in an economy
The income earned by individuals through their own business or self-employment
The total income earned by individuals and households before taxes and other deductions

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1) The income earned by individuals and households after taxes and other deductions**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Disposable income** is the amount of money that individuals and households have available for spending and saving after income taxes have been accounted for.
 
• This is the net income available to individuals after all mandatory deductions such as income tax, social security contributions, and other levies.
 
• It is a key indicator of the financial health of an individual or household, reflecting the amount of money available for discretionary spending or saving.
 
• Disposable income is crucial for understanding consumer behavior as it directly influences spending patterns and savings rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross income** is the total income earned by individuals and households before any deductions.
 
• **Net income** (or disposable income) is what's left after all deductions, including taxes, are taken out.
 
• Understanding the difference between gross and net income is essential for financial planning and budgeting.
 
• Higher disposable income generally indicates a higher standard of living and greater economic stability for households.

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution deals with the division of powers between the Union and the states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7th**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **7th Schedule** of the Indian Constitution deals with the division of powers between the Union and the states.
 
• It consists of three lists: the **Union List, State List, and Concurrent List**.
 
• The **Union List** includes subjects on which only the central government can legislate.
 
• The **State List** includes subjects on which only the state governments can legislate.
 
• The **Concurrent List** includes subjects on which both the central and state governments can legislate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **Union List** currently has 97 topics__, the **State List** has __66 topics__, and the **Concurrent List** has __47 topics__.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It defines the political principles, structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic**, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and promotes fraternity.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The 7th Schedule has been amended several times to accommodate the changing needs of the country.

questions.question: What is the name of the scheme launched by the Government of India for the financial inclusion of path or street vendors, whose anniversary was celebrated from July 9 to July 31, 2022?

• The scheme also incentivizes regular loan repayment with interest subsidies and provides the vendors with digital transaction rewards.
 
• It aims to benefit over **50 lakh (5 million) street vendors across India**, covering both urban and rural areas.
 
• The scheme's first anniversary was celebrated from** July 9 to July 31, 2022**, recognizing its impact and the progress made in achieving its goals.
